description: Check whether the site is published and return its live URL and latest report: broken_links, dead_nav_links, incoherent_pages, checks, design_gate, live_verified and SEO coverage. report.checked:true means a report was produced; report.audit_ran:false means the link, form and design audit did not run for this deploy, so findings are unavailable. Do NOT describe a publish as clean unless the audit ran. Read the report and offer fixes for findings, including forms that submit into the void, buttons do nothing, and hand-rolled auth. If audit_ran is false, run seo_audit on production_url. status is one of: published, deploying, not_published, unknown_app. This is the current state; do not poll repeatedly.

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

name: get_publish_status
title: Check Publish Status
